builds.name: Reference: Ranked jungle core
builds.goal: Reference for Kayn: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ jungle players use most (4,910 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 55.7% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: A form-dependent mobile fighter: Darkin favors sustained spell healing, while Shadow Assassin favors early combat burst. Terrain access and the chosen form should be considered before judging a single core. The current jungle provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: Voltaic Cyclosword → Black Cleaver → Death's Dance. Dark Harvest keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Ionian Boots of Lucidity, Guardian Angel, Sterak's Gage.
builds.summary: The proven jungle baseline: Voltaic Cyclosword → Black Cleaver → Death's Dance, with Dark Harvest.
testPlan: Play it in jungle as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (Voltaic Cyclosword → Black Cleaver → Death's Dance) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 55.7% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: Voltaic Cyclosword → Black Cleaver → Death's Dance.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.

builds.hypothesis: Rhaast Q's helpers combine total-AD physical damage and max-health damage with an AD[source modifier] term; Bloodmail adds AD from health, while Visage supports Darkin spell healing and R exit healing. Shojin favors repeated Q cycles, with E used to recover between fights.
testPlan: Required state: Select Darkin form and reach repeated Q hit opportunities.
Compare Q/R damage and healing at matched health with and without Bloodmail.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Healing reduction and wall exit restrictions prevent recovery.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Primary form tooltips are unresolved; exact helper dispatch and Stat(12) healing mapping stay uncertain.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Overlord's Bloodmail, Spear of Shojin, Black Cleaver, Spirit Visage, Sterak's Gage, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
